title: docstomd-ocr-local model catalog v1
description: Lists installable models. The built-in catalog ships with docstomd-ocr-local; user catalogs are passed with --ocr-catalog / --catalog or listed under "catalogs" in providers.json. Versioned independently of the OCR protocol and the manifest format.

runtimes.description: Native libraries for fast backends (ONNX Runtime), pinned per platform. Read from the built-in catalog only; user catalogs cannot supply runtimes.

languages.description: Language codes (ISO 639-1, optionally with a script or region such as zh-Hant) used by --ocr-lang.

license.description: SPDX identifier. Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD-2-Clause and BSD-3-Clause install directly; anything else needs --accept-license <license>.

manifest.description: Written to manifest.json in the model directory; its id must equal the entry id and every file it names must be downloaded.

source.description: hf://<org>/<repo>@<40-hex commit>/<file> (resolves to $HF_ENDPOINT or https://huggingface.co /<org>/<repo>/resolve/<commit>/<file>; $HF_TOKEN is sent for user catalogs only), or an https:// URL.
